title: Jev reviewers for functional review: a risk map of the diff and the user scenarios a PR likely changes

AC1.note: src/review/jev-risk.ts: RISK_DIMENSIONS (5), computeHunkRiskFacts (path class/exported symbols/nearby-test facts before any Jev call), batchRiskQuestionsForHunk, selectRiskHunks (--max-calls budget, skipped reported), rankHunksByRisk. Verified by src/review/jev-risk.test.ts (unit) and src/commands/review-jev-risk-cli.test.ts (CLI, fixture diff+responses). Live-checked on PR #712 (env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY, saved key, scratch dir): 15 hunks scored of 38 code hunks retained, 23 skipped by --max-calls, ranked output confirms combined-risk ordering (e.g. providers.ts:723-733 = 0.90).

AC2.note: synthesizeRiskFindings (severity capped info/minor, only above threshold AND no evidenced nearby test) and computeRiskRoutingHints (security/concurrency>=threshold -> review-security-code/review-highload) in src/review/jev-risk.ts; prose synthesized deterministically, Jev supplies only 5 probabilities. Unit tests cover threshold/nearby-test/severity/hint cases. Live PR #712 check: 0 findings (real nearby tests evidenced), 3 routing hints incl. providers.ts:1273-1301 concurrency=0.84 that a pre-fix run never scored at all (budget wasted on docs hunks) — see AC-tightening fixes in this same PR.

AC3.note: src/review/jev-scenarios.ts: scenarioFromWikiPage/scenariosFromPrd/scenariosFromReadmeLike (3 sources), computeScenarioFacts (touched-link fact), selectScenarios (touched-link-only candidates), one noul per scenario. Unit tests + CLI fixture tests pass. Live PR #712 check: 118 real scenario sources discovered from this repo's docs/requirements + docs/docs + README, 2 with a touched link, 1 batched Jev call.

AC4.note: buildScenarioChecklist (ranked, >=threshold) and synthesizeScenarioFindings (minor-only, no-covering-test fact) in src/review/jev-scenarios.ts; prose synthesized by keryx. Covered by jev-scenarios.test.ts and review-jev-scenarios-cli.test.ts (schema-validated finding).

AC5.note: Both commands opt-in via .metaproject/tasks.config.json review.jev.{risk,scenarios}; jevRiskGateRefusal/jevScenariosGateRefusal check opt-in then credential BEFORE any file read or network call (src/commands/review-jev-risk.ts, review-jev-scenarios.ts). Redaction: jev-scenarios.ts imports redactSensitiveText from ../security/service (the facade) directly; jev-risk.ts reaches redaction via conform-state.ts's hunkRedactedStateText, the same pre-existing sibling pattern ci-triage.ts/conform-jev.ts/turn-guard.ts/conform-clauses.ts already use. NOTE (Part A finding, info-severity): the frozen AC5 text says a non-opted-in run 'prints the deterministic facts only and says Jev was not asked' — actual behaviour (and its tests, titled 'both refuse before any read') is a full refusal with no facts printed, matching flow 330's review-jev-rules precedent exactly and arguably safer (no read at all vs. reading-then-not-asking). Confirmed on the stricter, precedent-matching behaviour actually shipped and tested, not the literal AC wording; flagged for the flow owner to reword AC5 via keryx flow ac update if desired.

AC6.note: src/tui/jev-risk-command.ts (/risk) and src/tui/jev-scenarios-command.ts (/scenarios): one-shot transcript render of ranked risk map + routing hints + findings, and manual-check list + findings, English UI (asserted not to match Cyrillic in render tests). Covered by jev-risk-command.test.ts and jev-scenarios-command.test.ts, hermetic (injectable gitDiff, gate refusal never shells out). All pass under bun ./scripts/opentui-tests-no-skips.ts src/tui (1279 pass, 0 skipped).

AC7.note: review-orchestrator/SKILL.md Wave B line (bundled + .metaproject mirror) lists review-jev-risk/review-jev-scenarios as additional, CLI-engine dispatches, never replacing an existing reviewer. src/review/reviewers.ts's metadata.engine reading (BundledReviewer.engine, collectReviewers, renderReviewerInventoryMarkdown) verified structurally identical to flow 330 PR #722's own reviewers.ts diff (byte-for-byte except a 'flow 330' vs 'flow 332' comment word) -- a later merge of the two PRs is a trivial/no-real-conflict merge on reviewers.ts. One caveat (Part A finding, info): both PRs also edit the SAME Wave B sentence in review-orchestrator/SKILL.md, which WILL show as a textual git conflict on whichever PR merges second (trivially resolved by concatenating both reviewer mentions, but not silently auto-mergeable) -- flagged for whoever merges second. keryx review reviewers --json lists engine: jev, covered by CLI tests.

AC8.note: Pure-function tests (jev-risk.test.ts, jev-scenarios.test.ts), CLI tests with fixture diffs/scope.json/canned Jev responses and reviewer-finding.schema.json validation (review-jev-risk-cli.test.ts, review-jev-scenarios-cli.test.ts), TUI render tests. All hermetic: mkdtemp under node:os tmpdir(), no real git/network, macOS-safe. Full run: typecheck clean, lint clean, bun test src/review/jev-risk* src/review/jev-scenarios* src/commands/review-jev-* src/tui/jev-* src/gdskills src/cli-reference-coverage.test.ts = 2246 pass/0 fail; bun scripts/opentui-tests-no-skips.ts src/tui = 1279 pass/0 skipped. Revert-checked: stashed src/review/jev-risk.ts, src/review/jev-scenarios.ts, src/commands/review-jev-risk.ts, src/commands/review-jev-scenarios.ts, src/tui/jev-scenarios-command.ts and reran the new/changed tests -- they failed (module load errors for isNonCodeHunk/SCENARIO_LINK_FANOUT_THRESHOLD, wrong finding counts for the hasNearbyTest and docs-hunk CLI tests) confirming they exercise the fix, not tautologies; then restored (stash pop) and reconfirmed green.

AC9.note: Operator/live-check note is explicitly out of scope for the agent per AC9 text; written by the lead in the operator's article notes outside the repo (~/notes/jev-in-keryx.md), not part of this repo or flow deliverable.

AC10.note: CI 19/19 green on PR #726 at headRefOid 6d750f3403c216dc07ac27a28f4fdfa4f71f8cb9 (18 SUCCESS + 1 SKIPPED deploy-to-Pages, no failures; gh pr view 726 --json statusCheckRollup). Docs updated in docs/docs/cli-reference.md (review jev-risk / review jev-scenarios sections) plus docs/requirements/keryx-jev-programme/PLAN.md. Merge commit 637156d3641d4524cee3d1e0dbc8198b2e4a597f.
